lines.line: A Few Good Men: published by the regular pipeline; TheWrap fixed by hand at 12:42am; 21 of 22 reviews live by 1:02am; reviews came out at 11:02pm, not the expected 10:00pm, so they were timed from 11:02pm; TheWrap went live at 1:24am (late); the first review was not live until 11:40pm (38 min after release); emails ready. Failed.

The Heart: published by the regular pipeline; 2 of 4 reviews live by 12:00am; Theater Pizzazz went live at 12:50am (late); Is Something Of A Miracle not live by 3:55am; Reddit draft emailed to you is out of date (score 73 from 8 reviews, the site shows score 78 from 14 reviews). Failed.
Kelly McCaughan: Catholic Guilt: not graded, the overnight check stopped before it finished.
The Greatest Story Ever: not graded, no reviews were published overnight.

The Lives of Others: published by the regular pipeline; no opening-night email draft yet (the site has 0 of the 8 reviews a draft needs). Not graded: could not check when the first review went live or the critics list at the 2-hour mark or which reviews came in that night or whether reviews stayed up.
